text: Search for files and directories named landing, and any 'landing' mentions in all file types, bounded by timeout.
command: cd /work && timeout 25 find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -iname '*landing*' -print 2>/dev/null | head -20; timeout 20 grep -rliE 'landing' --exclude-dir=node_modules --exclude-dir=.git --exclude-dir=.venv --exclude-dir=docs --exclude-dir=knowledge-base apps domains functions platform tools tests 2>/dev/null | head -20
